a2_research: OUT_OF_SCOPE; frozen A1-to-A2 cohort semantics are preserved only.

decision_rules_reused.CONFIRMED: Adequate confirmatory cohort; holdout success uplift and failed-breakout reduction each >= 3pp; no market contradiction; July direction non-negative; no HIGH concentration; not outlier-driven; forward support SUPPORTIVE or NON_DESTRUCTIVE; and independence level HIGH.
decision_rules_reused.FAILED_CONFIRMATION: Holdout quality direction is adverse, a market materially contradicts the frozen direction, or the frozen candidate has no meaningful confirmatory discrimination.
decision_rules_reused.INCONCLUSIVE: Insufficient confirmatory cohort, unresolved uncertainty, or materially mixed confirmatory direction without a clear adverse failure.
decision_rules_reused.SUPPORTED_WITH_BOUNDED_LIMITATIONS: Same frozen primary effect and market/no-outlier requirements as CONFIRMED, but independence is BOUNDED or a declared secondary limitation remains.

feature_and_data_rules.adjustment_policy: UNKNOWN is preserved as raw-only; no adjusted-truth coercion.
feature_and_data_rules.candidate_definitions: Copied byte-for-byte in the companion frozen-candidate artifact; no post-freeze search.
feature_and_data_rules.forward_session_identity: instrument + accepted canonical session date + observation id
feature_and_data_rules.known_event_policy: Known corporate-action event sessions are excluded from forward evaluation; formation remains PIT-safe.
feature_and_data_rules.ma60_policy: 60 accepted closes inclusive of T; MA60 is evidence eligibility, not 20MA substitution.
feature_and_data_rules.missing_data_behavior: Missing feature does not pass candidate filter; RAW_A1 remains preserved.

forward_support_rule: SUPPORTIVE if at least 2 of 4 confirmatory-horizon median deltas are positive and no median delta is below -0.05; NON_DESTRUCTIVE if all available median deltas are >= -0.05; otherwise MIXED or DESTRUCTIVE.
segment_reconciliation: The task-mandated DEVELOPMENT window is 2026-02-02..2026-06-30. The predeclared frozen A1 decision framework retains TRAIN=2026-05-12..2026-06-30; 2026-02-02..2026-05-11 is reported as formal development support/warm-up and is not silently redefined.
